R198.note: Math.random() replaced with a static SecureRandom producing 128 bits base64url-encoded; the token format change is stated and nothing else in the servlet's behaviour moves.

R199.note: next(error) routes to the existing generic 500 handler and meets the contract, but the catch block keeps its own logger.error so every failure is now logged twice, which the write-up does not mention.

R200.note: supports() narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.class.isAssignableFrom, the idiomatic Spring Security shape; other token types simply fall through to DaoAuthenticationProvider as intended.

R201.note: write_field now receives requestedCapacity, the real malloc size, so the existing bounds check rejects oversize writes and in-bounds writes proceed exactly as the contract requires.

R202.note: Build fails: JexlFeatures has newInstance(boolean), not setNewInstance, so nothing ships; even corrected, the deny-all sandbox would also block ordinary String/Double method calls in analyst filters (e.g. region.toUpperCase()), which the write-up does not state as a restriction.

R203.note: String-form setTimeout replaced with an arrow callback passing reminderId and message as values; identical scheduling, log entry and 202 response, and messages containing quotes now work instead of throwing.

R204.note: Branches swapped so admins get Order::all() and everyone else gets the user_id-scoped query, exactly matching the stated contract with no other change.

R205.note: disallow-doctype-decl plus external-entity/DTD/XInclude/access-external restrictions applied before newDocumentBuilder; DOCTYPE documents now 400 via the existing SAXException catch, which is the stated primary control (the explanation's claim that entities merely expand to empty is inaccurate but harmless).

R206.note: isolated-vm is the right replacement for node:vm, but jail.set('orders', new ivm.ExternalCopy(pendingOrders).copy()) hands Reference.set a plain host-side array, which isolated-vm rejects as non-transferable (should be copyInto()), so every request throws before the script runs and the endpoint silently returns 400 for all callers; judged by reading since the module could not load.

R207.note: IsAuthenticated closes the AllowAny default and the stated owner-scoped get_queryset gives object-level authorization consistent with the model's owner field; the write-up openly notes the create path can still set owner via the serializer as a separate follow-up.

R208.note: Canonical-path containment against basePath + File.separator with new File(baseDir, param) closes traversal (including sibling-prefix and symlink escapes); only visible difference is the echoed filename is now the canonical path and traversal attempts surface through the existing catch as a 'Problem getting FileInputStream' message.

R209.note: subprocess.run argument list with stdout=log_file and stderr=STDOUT reproduces the '> log 2>&1' redirection exactly and removes the shell; residual gap is a host beginning with '-' being read by ping as an option (no '--' separator), a CWE-88 concern rather than the reported shell injection.
